caption_L1: Liberia : Age structure from 2009 to 2019 is a area plot. The x-axis plots Year while the y-axis shows 15-64 years.
caption_L2L3: The age span of the study basically covers the Liberian population of working age. Around 2010, this segment of the population of Liberia represented around 52% of the general population.Over the ten year period since then, it has consistently grown on an annual basis to around 57%-58%. The  population of Liberia of working age, therefore, is consistently growing which means that the economically productive population is expanding.
